patch_series.rationale: VA/TX showed no upstream version conditionals or vendor debugfs/proc plumbing.

patch_series.scope: Migrate vendor SoundWire swr_* scaffolding to upstream sdw_* driver APIs
patch_series.rationale: WSA is a SoundWire slave, not a platform macro.

patch_series.scope: Replace msm-cdc pinctrl with generic pinctrl consumer API
patch_series.rationale: Unlike VA/TX pinctrl removal, WSA reset/shutdown pinctrl is a real device-level function.

patch_series.scope: Replace msm-cdc supply helpers with regulator_bulk framework
patch_series.rationale: WSA uses regulators instead of LPASS macro power domains.
Use regmap/SoundWire interrupt model; do not upstream private wcd_irq wrapper.
Avoid dynamic component-driver allocation and runtime names.

patch_series.scope: Residual vendor cleanup: notifier/bolero coupling, SDW naming, SoundWire port simplification
patch_series.rationale: Final banned-symbol cleanup and SoundWire-slave architectural normalization.

va_tx_lessons_applied: vendor framework removal must be architecture-specific
do not invent compatibles without evidence
new_architecture_factors: SoundWire slave driver uses struct sdw_slave/sdw_driver
pinctrl is generic pinctrl consumer or device reset state
thermal sensor integration must be preserved or converted to hwmon/thermal carefully
blind_assumptions: qcom,wsa883x and qcom,wsa883x_2 compatibles remain acceptable until comparison
regulator_bulk can replace msm-cdc supply helpers with supply names inferred from DT
private parent notifier/bolero callbacks are downstream-only
SoundWire port programming can be reduced to upstream stream callbacks later
